Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – proposal for the 2027 price basis and AS-14404 clause
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for taking the time to review our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels and appreciate your team's consideration of a longer-term arrangement.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 14 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Our annual requirement is 23,700 kg, with DAP delivery, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

For context, our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognize the cost pressures you described. We hope that prompt payment, a longer commitment and the proposed adjustment mechanism provide a useful basis for reviewing the starting price together. If a 24-month commitment would suit your team better, we would be pleased to discuss that as well.

Thank you again for considering the package. Could you kindly let us know what binding offer you can approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: part:370010 – revised proposal on your agreed structure
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer, and for accepting the 36-month term, 14-day payment and the AS-14404 clause. We appreciate the movement and your team's careful review.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.72/kg on the same structure? That means payment 14 days net, a 36-month contract, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. All enquiry terms stay unchanged: 23,700 kg/year, DAP, a 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

We recognise the annual increases you described. More recently, however, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). With the agreed clause, future material movements will be passed through in either direction.

It would also help us to understand two things. Which part of the annual cost increase is already reflected in the July 2026 price adjustment? Which part remains outstanding?

Thank you again. We look forward to the binding offer you can approve.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Kind regards,
Purchasing

move.subject: Part 370010 – a middle-ground proposal on the adjustment clause
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offers and for setting out two structures for us. We appreciate the effort your team has put into this, and we understand the annual cost pressures you described.

Having reviewed both packages carefully, we are unfortunately not able to approve either of them as offered.

Your 14-day offer kept a 0% deadband, while we had proposed 5%. Would you kindly consider a middle ground: EUR 5.01/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 3% deadband and base month 2026-08? All enquiry terms remain unchanged: 23,700 kg/year, DAP, a 14-day lead time, effective 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges. This is a new proposal for your approval, not an agreed term.

If the price itself is the obstacle, we would gladly accept your owner's kind offer from our 4 September call to walk us through your calculation. That would help us both see which cost element remains uncovered.

Thank you again for your patience.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
